summary: PASS. src/tests/git-clone.test.ts covers all 5 ACs with well-structured tests. Local fixture creates 2 commits on main + extra-branch for depth and branch option testing. file:// protocol correctly used to enable --depth for local clones. Real public repo test uses depth=1 for speed. Cleanup handler present. No blocking issues, no Fix-Forward applied. One documentation-forward tagged for the network-dependent test.

comments.note: No blocking issues. Test structure is clean and pattern-consistent across all dimensions. The local fixture (2 commits on main + extra-branch) is well-designed: it provides the depth > 1 history needed for the shallow-clone assertion and a named branch for the --branch option test. The file:// protocol for the depth test is the correct approach since git doesn't honour --depth on local paths without it.

[documentation-forward] The 'cloneRepository clones a real public repository' test has a hard network dependency on https://github.com/Mistralys/repo-parallelizer.git. This should be documented in the README or CI configuration (e.g., mark the test as requiring network access, or add a skip guard for air-gapped environments) so future contributors understand why the test suite may be slow or fail offline.
